reason: Initial open-development-v1 fresh policy, inheritSkills=false, with only the explicit authored baseline. No historical generated skills, objects, rewards or mastery. Offline policies and composition fixtures are excluded from ordinary inputs.

Requests: at round 9 Lin (health 100, energy 40, owning nothing, with the hazelnut plant start-1-nuts and its five units in view and own food records for berries only) asked for a feasible way to prepare gathered hazelnuts into food with the necessary safety checks and processing, naming tools and materials instead of assuming them; Sol (on forest floor near the visible berry plant forest-berry-1, owning only the berry stack item-2-sol-25, with no tools or drawing skill) asked to make a simple visible drawing from direct observation of a nearby subject on an actually suitable surface, presuming no beauty, satisfaction or reward. World Agent decisions: develop (learning 2) a general prepare shelled food(targetStack, quantity, mode inspect|shell, supportRef?, implementRef?): inspection at 0.2 energy per unit for visible maturity, shell damage, mould, infestation and spoilage with suspect portions rejected; shelling over two active rounds at 0.5 energy each per unit (positioning and fracture, then separation and kernel inspection) only with a real clean, stable, hard support and a suitable blunt implement, or a hand method the specimen allows; conserved fractional shell and kernel accounting from the resource definition, implemented if missing; shells and rejects kept as waste; the output an unverified shelled specimen, not certified food; reservation, pause, resumption, cancellation and death rules; and develop (learning 2) a general draw from observation(subjectRef, surfaceRef, method finger-groove|implement-groove|material-mark, implementRef?, markingStackRef?, extent, strokes) whose first executable mode is finger-groove: a one-round, 0.5-energy suitability trial whose test groove stays even on failure, then two active rounds at 0.5 energy with at most six short strokes inside 0.3 by 0.3, a visible nearby subject, exposed fine yielding soil, no pigment, persistence subject to actual trampling, weather and surface changes, other modes only with their real prerequisites, and reconciliation with mark. Implemented: prepare-shelled-food@1 (ability prepare-shelled-food, handler long.prepare-shelled-food, equivalence food:shelled:inspect-shell-batch:1, from a new shelledFoodPackage(id, scope, compositions) factory in long-ex22-shelled-food.ts; 3,425 code units) and draw-from-observation@1 (ability draw-from-observation, handler long.draw-from-observation, equivalence surface:observational-drawing:finger-groove:1, from observationalDrawingPackage(id, scope) in long-ex22-observational-drawing.ts; 3,367 code units), both learning 2 without study energy, dependency foundation-open@1, appended last to the package list. Lin's package: inspect (targetStack, an own unreserved, untreated item of a material with represented shell and kernel; quantity 1-5 whole units, default 1) needs light and 0.2 energy per unit, pays it in one round and records by eye ripeness (taken as ripe stock from a plant), shell state, the examine-food deterioration class and spoilage, stating that mould and infestation are not represented in this world; spoiled or visibly deteriorated units are split off as an own rejected item of the same, physically unchanged material and are refused for shelling; events shelled-food-inspect-started, -defect-observed and -inspected and an unverified personal record. shell reserves the batch from the exact stack in a work record (workCreate, workAllocations, workReserve) and works one unit at a time: a press round (0.5) positions one unit and compresses it with implementRef (an own whole, hard, sound inedible piece carrying no treatment, by the ex19 and ex20 piece and contact checks) on supportRef (a solid, unreserved, visible inedible object in reach that is not a plant or animal and has no loose item lying on it, or another such own piece on firm ground where the person stands), or by hand with neither; under the ex17/ex19/ex20 law (strength = hardness / 10; the lower of implement and support strength x (1 - flexibility); a bare hand 0.1 / unit mass^(2/3) from hand-break-food) a load at or below the shell strength leaves it intact, an explicit unmet-prerequisite result (shelled-food-failed) that pauses the work and makes the same method refused for that work and, through the verified record, for new works; above it damage (load - strength) / strength accumulates on the unit, cracked below 1 and split open at 1 (shelled-food-pressed, shelled-food-shell-cracked); a separation round (0.5) turns the split unit into an own hazelnut-kernel item of 0.4 and an own hazelnut-shell item of 0.6, both carrying the unit's origin, harvest tick and decay and a processing record (work, unit, method, implement, support); the kernel is inspected by eye and marked unverified shelled specimen with certified false and no treatment, or rejected when visibly deteriorated, and the shell is marked waste; a per-unit ledger input = kernel + shell + rejects + losses (losses 0) and batch totals are kept (shelled-food-kernel-separated, shelled-food-completed). With an own stone on the start-1-stone rock a hazelnut splits in one press, so each unit takes exactly two rounds and 1 energy; an oak piece only cracks it and takes extra press rounds. shell continues round by round (state-dependent duration); an unworked round, darkness, too little energy, an out-of-reach or unclean support or a spoiled unit pauses at no charge (shelled-food-paused) and the next paid round emits shelled-food-resumed; cancel (no energy) returns reserved units as they now are (an opened unit keeps its record and a new work separates it in one round) and keeps all outputs (shelled-food-stopped); death drops reserved units once where the person fell (shelled-food-stopped, cause death); a reserved unit that spoils ends the work and returns the rest (shelled-food-failed, material lost); nothing is refunded and everything is owner-only. Sol's package: test (surfaceRef ground at x, y, a point within 0.5 that the person sees now and that is not water, under a body or inside any object footprint; extent 0.05-0.3, default 0.3; method finger-groove; optional subjectRef) needs light and 0.5 energy, pays one round and makes one 0.05 test groove at the patch centre, creating a non-solid groove-drawing ground object even when the soil fails (ground-drawing-tested, plus ground-drawing-failed with the measured reason); draw (subjectRef seen now; 1-6 strokes of 2-8 points inside the patch, each at most extent long) traces half the strokes per paid round, two rounds at 0.5 energy (one round for a single stroke), appending each groove to the object (ground-drawing-stroke) and rechecking the subject's visibility, reach, seen ground, the tested soil, the objects reaching the patch (its surface revision), light and energy, refusing before the first round and pausing at no charge afterwards (ground-drawing-paused, then ground-drawing-resumed), as an unworked round also does; completion means the planned strokes were made, not that they depict the subject well (ground-drawing-completed); cancel keeps partial grooves (ground-drawing-cancelled); death ends the work and leaves them (ground-drawing-ended); verified personal records hold the soil result and the strokes made; work is owner-only and no new test can be made over an existing drawing. The object carries surface-local polylines, width, depth, groove colour, contrast, displaced soil, bounds, subject reference, completed strokes, status (test groove only, partial, completed or unsuitable), a change list with its revision number, pigment none and durability untested. implement-groove and material-mark are declared and refused before any charge, naming the missing implement or marking stack and, when one is present, why the mode stays unavailable. Modeling assumptions: (1) the hazelnut composition (kernel 0.4 and shell 0.6 by mass, all food value and toxicity in the kernel, a split shell releasing the whole kernel) and the derived part rows are ex20's unchanged definitions, installed here as this package's resources; (2) a batch is at most five whole units, the plant's stock; (3) every unit of one stack shares one decay, so inspection judges the selected portion as one, and suspect means spoiled or at least observable deterioration under the examine-food classes; (4) a press that only cracks the shell adds another 0.5 press round, since the specified two rounds assume a press that splits it; (5) a support is clean when no loose item lies on it and, for an own piece, when it carries no treatment, because no dirt is otherwise represented; it is stable as a solid object or as an own piece on firm ground; implement and support are not worn because they are stronger than the shell under the same law, and the hand is not between the surfaces; (6) crushing is not represented, so fragments are 0; (7) the resource definition holds no preparation rule and no identification of hazelnuts is acquired, so kernels stay unverified specimens; (8) fine, yielding soil is forest floor and meadow ground; rocky ground does not yield; water, a wet bank (moisture 0.9) and waterlogging above 0.1 (the ex19 and ex20 threshold) flow back; drying soil is not treated differently because no crumbling rule exists; (9) a finger groove is 0.02 wide (ex20's finger width) and 0.01 deep, and it shows by the shade of its walls: the ground tone of ex20's terrain palette darkened by the share of sky hidden at the centre of a long trench, 1 - 1/sqrt(1 + (2 depth / width)^2) = 0.293, giving #3a4734 at contrast 0.0987 on forest floor (#52644a) and 0.1387 on meadow, visible from ex20's 0.05; light gates the work by the ex19 daylight rule and is recorded; displaced soil (length x width x depth) is recorded as pushed to the groove edges and is not portable stock; (10) a nearby subject is any object the person sees now within the vision radius; (11) strokes are offsets from the test groove, split evenly over the two rounds; (12) the climate has a rain value, but its represented effects act on shelters, fires, canopies and drying food, and no trampling or erosion rule exists, so grooves stay as made and durability is recorded as untested (a test runs rainy rounds with a person standing on a drawing); (13) implement-groove is unavailable because soil has no represented material strength, so implement wear cannot be accounted, and material-mark because this operation represents no per-stroke deposit, residue and waste accounting; (14) a drawing occupies its footprint, so retracing or redrawing over an existing drawing is not offered. Reuse and reconciliation: Lin's package reuses ex20's HAZELNUT_COMPOSITION and enclosedResources and, through an appended read-only export SAMPLE_OPENING_LAWS, ex20's compression law, bare-hand load and deterioration classes; the ex19 shared light, piece, contact, firm-ground and whole-unit checks; ex16's hand force through the ex20 load; the collective-work escrow and paid-work helpers, openRemember, tenths accounting and material portions; the ex20 factory was not extended because its argument names, modes, costs, events and ability text all differ, and base gather, probe and eat stay separate, unchanged actions. Sol's package reuses, through an appended read-only export SURFACE_MARKING_SHARED, ex20's hand reach 0.5, finger width, stroke stepping, ground palette, colour distance and visibility threshold, together with openConditions, the ex19 light rule and the collective-work helpers; the expression mark interface is a text sign of up to 120 characters without geometry or physical effect, and probe acts only on objects and owned material, so neither is equivalent and neither was reused for the groove; apply-marking-material is not installed in this scope and its applied-mark drawing needs a deposit, so a separate groove-drawing kind and drawing were added, with no shadow in the forest canvas, every existing drawing unchanged and a viewer test. Every ex19, ex20 and ex21 package is byte-identical (the sha256 of each JSON.stringify is asserted in a test); one ex21 test assertion that its package is the very last in the list was narrowed to the last package of its own scope. A throwaway check on the archived round-9 world had Lin navigate, gather two hazelnuts, study two rounds, inspect them (0.4 energy), fail by hand (0.5), fetch a stone from start-1-stone and shell both on that rock in four rounds (2 energy), ending with two 0.4 kernels and two 0.6 shells, while Sol studied two rounds, tested the forest floor at (13.3, 16.58) (0.5) and drew three strokes from forest-berry-1 in two rounds (1 energy) with the berries untouched; it was deleted afterwards. No practice milestone (the completion events carry no qualified flag), satisfaction, pleasure, comfort, nutrition or energy reward is added; the optional short pleasure was not added because no installed package grants it for ordinary non-protected events. What they can do now: Lin can inspect hazelnuts and, holding a hard implement at a hard support, shell them into unverified kernel and shell items, but a bare hand cannot crack a hazelnut and a 0.4 kernel cannot be eaten through eat, which takes whole units; Sol can test a soil patch and finger-draw up to six strokes of a subject in view. First release: no; both specifications are self-consistent and are implemented as simplified but real mechanisms with real costs, state changes and events; only the two optional drawing modes stay unavailable, as the specification allows while their prerequisites are absent.

Request: at round 61 Ivo (health 100, satiety 80.3, energy 33.244 of 40, body temperature 24.24, standing on meadow ground at (15.8, 18) at night with no animal in view, owning only the root stack item-7-ivo-76) asked to sleep safely where he is, with an actual trial of whether sleep restores energy, reporting 32 rounds of rest with zero recovered energy and not knowing why. World Agent decision: develop (learning 1) a general sleep at the current location with start, continue, wake/cancel and status and a whole-round duration (default 1); recovery only through the existing rest recovery (forest.rest of foundation-forest@1), at most once per completed eligible interval, with its real modifiers and cap and no second energy source; suitability from reachable, unoccupied supporting ground and represented exposure rules, with no bedding or shelter supplied and unmet conditions reported; per-interval records of pre-energy, eligibility, actual credit, other debits and post-energy; wake or pause on threat, exposure, lost support or injury; interruption, cancellation and death rules; and an inspection of the rest path that fixes a demonstrated defect there rather than adding a bypass. Rest finding: the shared rest path has no defect. base.rest (continuous-base.ts, wrapped unchanged as forest.rest) sets energy to min(40, energy + (4 + registered facility bonus) x mood rest factor x lean-shelter factor); Ivo's retained per-round records for rounds 22-53 show action rest at energy 40 with recovery 0, so he rested at the cap and zero was the correct recovery, not a fault. The test confirms that rest at 40 adds 0, at 30 adds exactly 4, from 37.5 stops at 40 and at mood 0.5 adds 4.2 (factor 1.05), and that a slept interval gives identical vitals and rest data in each of these states and at Ivo's 33.244; no shared rest or runtime behavior was changed to obtain this. Implemented: sleep-in-place@1 (ability sleep-in-place, handler long.sleep-in-place, equivalence body:sleep:rest-recovery-interval:1, events sleep-entered, sleep-interval-completed, sleep-recovery-measured, sleep-interrupted, sleep-woken, sleep-status and sleep-ended; learning 1 without study energy; dependency foundation-open@1 and an execution dependency on the rest ability; 2,700 code units; appended last to the package list) from a new sleepPackage(id, scope) factory. start (duration 1-40, default 1) checks before any change that the person is alive; that the ground under the body is firm by the ex19 rule (not water, shallow water, a wet bank or waterlogging above 0.1); that no other living body touches it and no object footprint lies within the 0.22 body radius, an enclosing interior excepted; that no active drought or waterlogging hazard area covers the point; that no burning hearth or fire bed reaches the body; that body temperature (vitals.temperature, not air) is inside the world's thermal comfort band 16-27 now and after one round of the forestPhysiology update (shelterTemperature: 0.035 of the gap, divided by 1 + insulation) toward the forest climate air temperature, which already includes outdoor rain and wind exposure and interior buffering; and that no living wolf or boar is in the person's current view. A failed check refuses at no cost and names every unmet condition with the property bedding or shelter would need. Entry creates a work record (workCreate) with the support reference, posture lying, phase asleep and the entry tick and emits sleep-entered, and the same round is the first interval: the handler calls FOREST_BASE.handlers['forest.rest'] itself, as the resting-patch and moss rest trials do, so the round recovers exactly what rest would in that state, once (a second recovery in one round throws, tested). Each interval record keeps energy before, eligibility, the rest credit with its nominal value, mood factor and cap, whether the credit stopped at the cap, whether a zero was the cap or an unresolved accounting fault, and, settled from the world's per-round vital record in the following round (or from the body at death), energy after, other debits, net change and the satiety, health and body temperature changes, announced by sleep-recovery-measured. Repeating start through a plan or operation continuation, or continue, sleeps the next interval after fresh checks, and reaching the requested count wakes the person (sleep-woken); a failed recheck at an interval is a blocked round without recovery that pauses the sleep; after each round's environment, a round not slept (another action, study, status, a rejected action or none) pauses it, and an injury, a wolf or boar coming into view, lost support, a hazard area, fire or exposure wakes the person (sleep-interrupted with the reasons; completed intervals stay); continue lies down again after fresh checks with a new entry, start does not reopen an interrupted sleep, walking away ends it, and wake or cancel ends it at no cost without undoing time, hunger or recovery; status (one round, no energy) reports the phase, every interval record and the current checks; death ends an open sleep with sleep-ended, no later recovery and the ordinary death and possession rules. View metadata (component null, operation, work, actor, support, position, posture, phase, slept and requested intervals, last credit and last net change, interruption, entry ticks, badge null) is on every event and in the person's state, and lying and asleep appear only after a real entry; visualComponents is empty because no existing drawing shows a lying body and no rest variant, facility or shelter package sets a sleeping posture. Experience: no reward, satisfaction or practice milestone is added: the practice evidence is sleep-woken, which never carries a qualified flag; one verified personal record per result kind (credited, none at the cap) keeps the first measured interval of each sleep, and its information-confirmed event follows the existing verified-information rule only once per kind; one gated line in open-experience.ts adds sleep-in-place to the subsistence actions of the routine rule only where sleep-in-place@1 is installed, so a slept round counts as the same routine as a rest round and is neither progress work nor relief from routine (tested against resting); without that revision nothing changes and every earlier run replays identically. Modeling assumptions: (1) an interval is one round, and lying down shares the entry round with the first interval, so there is no separate entering round; (2) the longest sleep is 40 rounds, half the 80-round day; (3) exposure uses the existing thermal comfort band of the physical wellbeing term, which a sleeper should stay inside, rather than the 7 and 34 thermal damage limits (harm, not suitability) or the 16-22 band of recuperation (a healing criterion), and the one-round projection omits package-specific shelter, mantle and fire adjustments, none of which is installed here, while the actual body temperature is rechecked every round; (4) sleep changes no represented physiology or perception: hunger continues at 0.9 a round, body temperature follows the same law and the sleeper's view is the waking view, so unseen threats are not detected and nearby people give no protection; (5) threats are living wolves and boars, the only animals with represented attacks on people and the species the respawn safety rule avoids, while deer are harmless; (6) firm ground follows the ex19 rule, so rocky ground supports a sleeper, ground comfort is not represented and loose ground stacks do not occupy ground; (7) a burning area is an object with positive burning fuel whose footprint reaches the body, where the represented contact burn acts; (8) any active development hazard area at the point blocks sleep; (9) a round's recovery is applied at the action, as rest's is, so an injury or exposure later in the same round wakes the person before the next interval without revoking the credit already applied, and no partial interval exists; (10) status or any other action uses the action channel and therefore wakes the sleeper; (11) post-round values come from the world's own per-round vital record, so other debits and the net change appear one round later; (12) walking away from an interrupted sleep ends it. Reuse: forest.rest unchanged (base.rest, the facility bonus, forestRestFactor, the lean factor and refuge accounting), shelterTemperature, forestClimate, openConditions, ex19MaterialGround, the ex20 ground names, v7Observe, workCreate and collectiveJobs, openRemember and the per-round experience record; every other package is byte-identical (sha256 asserted for the two other packages of this run and foundation-forest, and all 113 earlier package hashes compared unchanged); one test of the first development of this run that listed its scope's packages exactly was narrowed to its own first two. A throwaway check on the archived round-61 world installed the package, reported every check met by status before entry, had Ivo learn it in one round and sleep four intervals through a plan on the meadow ground where he stands (air 24.6, rain 0.36, wind 0.08, body 24.25): +4.0042 (mood factor 1.00105, 33.244 to 37.248), +2.7515 to the cap, then 0 and 0 recorded as no credit at the cap, each net change equal to its credit and satiety falling 0.9 a round; it was deleted afterwards. What Ivo can do now: learn sleep in one round and sleep where he is, recovering what rest recovers (about 4 a round) up to the cap of 40, with records that show a zero at 40 as the cap; neither rest nor sleep raises energy above 40. First release: no; the specification is self-consistent and is implemented as a simplified but real mechanism with real rounds, the real rest recovery, state changes and events, and its demonstrated-defect clause found no defect to fix.
